title: Research Methodology
tagline: From question to design: building your own inquiry.
welcome: This course moves you from reading research to designing it. Your questions about young people deserve rigorous answers; here is how to build them.
vignette: A student notices that her school's mindfulness program seems to help some students and not others. She turns that observation into a question, a design, and a plan. Research methodology is the bridge from curiosity to contribution.
vignette_attr: A student's emerging inquiry, drawn from supervision
description: An advanced course in research methodology for the counseling researcher: formulating research questions and hypotheses, quantitative and qualitative design, sampling and measurement, ethics and consent with minors, data collection and basic analysis, and writing a method section.
questions: Which design best answers my question, ethically?
How do I protect young participants while I learn from them?
importance: Your thesis and future practice depend on sound method
Method rigor is an ethical obligation to participants
The field advances one careful study at a time
misconceptions: that methodology is statistics, when it is the logic of valid inference
that qualitative is soft, when it is rigorously systematic
figures: whose work on validity and design remains foundational
whose qualitative rigor shaped the field
outcomes: You will turn observations into precise questions.
You will match design to question and ethics.
You will select samples and instruments validly.
You will design consent and protection into studies.
You will plan quantitative or qualitative analysis coherently.
You will produce a clear, replicable method.
modules: A good question is half the study.
Design determines what you may claim.
Ethics is designed in, not bolted on.
Analysis follows from design and question.
Write so a stranger could repeat you.
practicum: Practice is designing your own study.
A research question and design workshop
assessment: A research proposal with method section
tips: Pilot everything on two people first
Choose the smallest design that answers the question
Write the method before you collect a single datum
integration: Methodology directly feeds your Master Thesis and lifelong scholarly practice.
faith: We pursue knowledge with integrity, as stewards of the truths entrusted to us.
closing: May your questions be worthy and your methods sound, and may your inquiry serve the young.
